cells: Can direct CBI or its own wing

blocks.content: The Lokpal shall have powers of superintendence over, and direction to, any investigating agency including the Delhi Special Police Establishment for cases referred to them by the Lokpal.

rows: Respective State Legislations (First established in Maharashtra, 1971)
Prime Minister, Central Ministers, MPs, Central Govt Officers
Chief Minister, State Ministers, MLAs, State Govt Officers
Superintendence over CBI for referred cases

items: Inquiry against the Prime Minister requires a full bench Lokpal hearing and approval by at least two-thirds of its members.
Lokpal cannot inquire into PM corruption allegations relating to international relations, external and internal security, public order, atomic energy, and space.
Complaints cannot be entertained by Lokpal if filed after seven years from the date on which the offense was allegedly committed.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Lokpal has jurisdiction over the Prime Minister, Union Ministers, Members of Parliament, and Groups A, B, C, and D officers.
It possesses powers of superintendence and direction over investigating agencies, including the CBI, for cases referred by it.
Lokpal enjoys the powers of a Civil Court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, for summoning witnesses and demanding documents.
It can authorize provisional attachment of assets acquired through corrupt means while an investigation is underway.
Entities receiving foreign contributions exceeding ₹10 Lakh per year under FCRA also fall within Lokpal's jurisdiction.
